title: Q4 Product Launch Alignment
summary: Three answers already exist. The meeting was scheduling, not deciding.
shortRequest: Align Marketing, Product and Sales on our Q4 launch and decide the final launch date.
request: We need to align Marketing, Product and Sales on our Q4 launch. We need to decide the final launch date.

intro.headline: Meetings are not the problem.
lines: A 50-person SaaS company is preparing its Q4 launch. The CEO needs one date agreed.
So the request becomes a meeting — and the meeting becomes three days of coordination.
SYNCLESS asks a different question first: how much of this actually needs everyone in a room?

before.verdict: Seven steps, three days, ten calendars — to settle one date that three people already knew.
before.note: The problem is not the 90 minutes. The problem is synchronizing ten people to reach a decision three of them already hold.

analysis.headline: Most of the information required for this decision already exists. The remaining uncertainty can be resolved asynchronously without requiring real-time discussion.
reasoning: 82% of the required information already exists in the Marketing plan, Product roadmap and Sales commitments.
The open question resolves to 3 factual confirmations with named owners — not a trade-off debate.
Stakeholder conflict is low: no participant has an interest that opposes another's.
10 participants × 90 minutes of blended synchronous time costs NT$13,500 in coordination.
Collecting the three answers asynchronously leaves a 15-minute review to confirm the date.
analysis.cost_basis: 10 participants × 1.5 h × NT$900 blended hourly = NT$13,500

questions.question: What is the earliest realistic launch date?
Is the product technically ready by October 15?
Do any existing customer commitments conflict with October 15?

decision.title: Q4 Launch Decision
decision.recommendation: October 15 is confirmed as the Q4 launch date. Marketing and Product are both ready, and Sales reports no blocking customer conflicts. What remained was a 15-minute review to confirm — not a 90-minute meeting to discover.
post_approval: Decision logged to the Q4 launch record with all three sources
Head of Product notified as decision owner
Notice scheduled for the two enterprise customers
The original 10-person, 90-minute meeting request was never created

routes.name: AI HANDLES IT
routes.description: SYNCLESS answers directly from existing systems and logs the answer.
routes.rejectedBecause: Two inputs — the realistic launch date and the customer conflict check — require a named human to stand behind them.
notes: The earliest realistic launch date — a Marketing judgement, not a stored fact
Customer conflicts — a Sales commitment that needs an owner

routes.name: ASYNC FIRST
routes.description: SYNCLESS asks the three owners targeted questions, synthesizes the answers and drafts the decision.
routes.selectedBecause: 82% information sufficiency with only 38% meeting necessity — the answers exist and need collecting, not debating.

routes.name: MEETING
routes.description: Escalate to a live session when the trade-off is genuine and stakeholders conflict.
routes.rejectedBecause: Meeting necessity 38% with low stakeholder conflict — there is no trade-off here that needs arguing in real time.

flag.label: Constraint detected

synthesis: 3 of 3 responses collected in 41 minutes. No conflicts. One constraint surfaced and carried into the decision: two enterprise customers need advance notice of the October 15 date.

routeLocked.label: Coordination cost avoided
routeLocked.caption: 3 targeted questions to 3 named stakeholders · no calendar invite created

roi.headline: We turned a 90-minute coordination meeting into a 15-minute decision review.
roi.footnote: Same decision. Same confidence. A fraction of the synchronization.

closing.statement: We don't manage meetings. We eliminate the meetings your company never needed.
